Cube004_1.title: Classification model performance monitoring and forecast

panel.hook: Estimating model performance in production — without ever seeing the ground truth.

description.heading: Mission Brief
description.content: A production-oriented monitoring system that estimates classification model performance when true labels aren't available, combining confidence-based metrics with drift detection to catch silent model degradation early.

overview.heading: What It Does
items: Estimates classification performance without ground truth labels
Combines confidence-based metrics with univariate and multivariate drift detection
Validated across four datasets, including a simulated credit-scoring environment
Enables early detection and explanation of performance degradation

howItWorks.heading: Under the Hood
howItWorks.content: The system tracks shifts in input feature distributions (univariate and multivariate drift) alongside model confidence signals, correlating both against known degradation patterns to flag when a live model's real-world accuracy is likely slipping.
